notes.title: The “Blood Flowers” full version is here!!!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I'm Ocarina!
The countdown to the full release of " Blood Flowers " has begun! During this time, our team has grown from 3 to 8 people, with the number of cats increasing to 6. The new programmer also brought a lop-eared rabbit named "Latte," and the diversity of the entire studio has greatly improved!
Of course, I am still at the bottom of the food chain.
This won't change.
Just like our original intention to create a good game won't change.
Just like the protagonist in " Blood Flowers " who fought against the meteor and brought a curse of darkness that lasted for hundreds of years, the desire to protect our family will never change.
For this official release, we have mainly added the following content:

[h2][The following contains spoilers, so please be careful if you haven't played the EA version.][/h2]


[h3]Current version status:[/h3]

The proofreading has optimized the entire English text.

A second possibility was added for Sue Bai's life path, and as a result, the fate of Bai City has diverged (a new game ending was added). A small compensation was given to Sue Bai and her father to face the past. Some additional details were added to the relationship between Professor Zhang and Dean Bai. Some CG images were optimized, and a new CG image for the eldest niece was added. Save and load functions were also optimized to ensure smooth operation. Several bugs were fixed, including but not limited to: scenes freezing during the transition, inability to interact in some rare situations, audio glitches, certain achievements being unattainable, save/load achieves, interface display errors when zooming in/out, freezing during puzzle solving for the Wooden box and Huarong Road, misplaced interaction for ball-rolling puzzles, and a host of other minor issues that were fixed on the fly.

[h3]Why switch to the official release:[/h3]

" Blood Flowers " is our first released work. We stumbled our way here today and met many people who helped us. We are very grateful to everyone who participated in the “Blood Flowers” development and provided feedback! The reason for the "official release" is to make it available in its final version and to mark a small milestone for our team's growth. However, it does not mean that we will stop updating " Blood Flowers ", and exploring its characters and stories.

[h3]What are we planning to do next?[/h3]

The first is the related branching story of "Blood Flowers". Friends and family who have played the game should have seen some possibilities beyond the main storyline in "The LanZhuTang Notes"! We will continue to expand on these ideas.
Next, in the same world system, but further into the unknown and unknowable "Sea of Bubbles," we are also working on the development of "Yog-Sothoth’s Yard". Both stories have some connections to each other, and interested players can explore them. [spoiler] Oops, I accidentally revealed it! A major event!! The entire Bone Nail Studio has been swallowed up!! We're doomed!! [/spoiler]

"Yog-Sothoth’s Yard" expands our worldview and is a small step forward in gameplay exploration. We have always believed that making a single-player game should be enjoyable (S.I.D is coughing blood in the background), but it's not just about storytelling, it also needs to be fun. To achieve this, we have put in a lot of effort and sacrificed our health in various ways (I am coughing blood on the keyboard). At present, we can only say that our vision and boundaries have once again expanded. [spoiler]Yes, our vision has expanded, we have seen ■■■■■, and we have gained some strange knowledge!!!! [/spoiler] Recently, our team has experienced many things, we have (been forced to) move and some of our colleagues have suffered a lot in their personal lives. Two of our colleagues have problems with their lumbar spine. Nevertheless, we have survived! We will continue to live, make games, and make better games. Every bit of support is a light on our journey. Thank you very much for reading this far!! [spoiler]Experts! Please don't leave yet! Please give us a good review!!!! [/spoiler]

Recently, our team has experienced a lot of changes, such as moving to a new location, and some of our members have faced many personal challenges, such as back problems. Nevertheless, we have overcome these obstacles and survived. We will continue to live and make games, better games. Every bit of support from you is a ray of light on our journey. Thank you very much for reading this far!
[spoiler]Hey, senior players! Don't leave! Please give us a good review![/spoiler]

notes.title: Astrology, a kind of naming metaphysics
notes.notes:
Hello! I'm Ocarina, the game mover. Naming is a kind of metaphysics, for example, I don't want to tell you that the name "Ocarina" actually comes from The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time.
And the name of the character in "Bloody Flowers"  in the names of the characters are also buried in a little ambush, I believe that the players who have played the DEMO should have completely GET!
It does not matter if you do not get it, I'm the spoiler today.
(Dragged away and beaten by Jiabai......)

I' m crawling back, I have to be dramatic today.

[Yinchen Zhang]
The first is the main character Yinchen Zhang. The family name Zhang is followed by his adoptive father's family name, if you played the DEMO should know.
"Yinchen" means "hidden Mercury". Mercury, the ancient Chinese called the star of "Chen". I do not know if you know the previous Mawangdui unearthed silk book in the sentence "five planets out of the East to benefit the middle Kingdom", every teenager should be for the blood it! The Book of <TianGuanShu> also has a similar description, "five planets in the sky, accumulate in the East, benefit the middle Kingdom; accumulate in the West, benefit the foreign Kingdom. Five planets belong to Mercury and are gathered in a direction, which means the country of its direction can rule the world."
In other words, the magical star Mercury will lead the five planets to concentrate in one direction of the heavenly wall, and the country in that direction will "rule the world".
Giving the name to the main character also contained a lot of expectations yooo~.
However, he is not a shining Mercury, but a hidden Mercury. That's why some players said, "I feel he was upset to see the drawing at the beginning", because at the beginning Yinchen does not know what to pursue in his life, just like meteorites, collect meteorites. As he explores his memories, he gradually has richer human feelings, and also in our conception of the series eventually to his alienation, with stronger power, to fight the unnameable alien god.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42704084/2d67c950464a8b17509f29776781e9ecf91e13f2.jpg[/img]

[Vulkan]
When we talk about the planet Mercury, there is a prophecy in astronomy that "there is a star between Mercury and the Sun", which prediction came from various calculations in astronomy. This star, which has not been seen, is believed to exist and is called "Vulcan", or Vulkan.
Of course, as science and technology progressed, the advent of high-definition astronomical telescopes made it clear to scientists that there was no such star as Vulcan. Instead, over the long years, astrology and the occult have often recorded, speculated, and acted on it as part of the celestial orbit, and as part of the influence of fate ............
From this perspective, this guy Vulkan was the antithesis of Yinchen from the beginning, but he represented the kind of dark, wise and strong power that also always attracted to Yinchen ............
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42704084/c71dd5b9ec9a45d32a6dc47316011020be43ccd6.jpg[/img]
 
[Nix]
Some buddies have already found out that the black-hearted boss of the Meteorite Association, The queen of dark circles under the eyes of green-haired, The guy who can't even die from a blimp jump, the lover of sweet and sour pork, and Miss Nix, who has mechanical prostheses, the goddess of the blackness of Greek mythology.
And at the time of our naming, her name comes mainly from the second moon of Pluto, Nix, the goddess of the night.
That is to say, the five moons of Pluto have all been
Charon the ferryman of hell, Nix the goddess of the night, Hydra the nine-headed snake, Cerberus the three-headed dog of hell, and Styx the goddess of the river Styx.
(That is, the President of our Meteorite Association can also be called Sister of Pluto's second moon)
Using Nix to name the President of the Meteorite Association actually contains another big hole that we dug ......
In the fight against ■■■■■, the members, including Nix, are like Pluto and the moons guarding the farthest reaches of the solar system, maintaining the faltering civilization at the edge of human reason and knowledge, and fighting against the tumbling sea of gray ......... ...
No wonder the dark circles under the eyes are so heavy, Miss President!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42704084/5a5344e741f662cc28c3ffaabbcbcc6d37726aad.jpg[/img]

That's it for naming characters related to astrology!
Next time, we'll tell you about our other roles related to plants, especially the Bai family ............

notes.title: I dug a big hole for myself
notes.notes:

Recently we released the DEMO page on STEAM [Bloody Flowers], and then several brothers in the studio jerked the cat every day and prayed: one more player to play our game, one more player to play our game, another one more.........
There is not anything that can help. 

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42704084/6a571a6c38a61b4c2878b43e7ada043d81d02691.jpg[/img]

notes.title: From alchemy to the seed of ■■■■■
notes.notes:
Hello, brothers who play the game! I'm your game mover, Ocarina. It's finally not hot anymore! The air conditioner isn't tripping anymore either. Maybe a lot of things in life are like this, when you need it he has frequent problems, and when you don't need it he's fine again ......
After we put a little demo, yesterday a group of friends asked me why there is an alchemical array in the game. I: This is a complicated question, but I can not dramatize it............

I really want to go back to yesterday to kill this pretentious self.
When we first planned the game, it was determined that this would not be a single story but a series of stories, each of which would give birth to a "monster" - a beast hatched by combining the seed of■■■■■ and human nature. And this combination is equivalent to modifying the nature of "life", as if the hand of God changed the genetic button, creating a new life.

In order to give such a mechanism a suitable vehicle, we chose Alchemy. Not only because Alchemy has such a widely known example of human beings Alchemy ......
And Alchemy's graphics, symbols, algorithms, not to do puzzle solving pity ah!

The essence of Alchemy, whose source is the <Emerald Tablet>, can also be regarded as the progenitor of modern chemistry. It analyzed elements, combined elements, and tried various equivalent substitution elements to achieve the purpose of transforming other elements into gold, and then Nicolas Flamel created the legend of the Philosopher's Stone, which led the simple "Alchemy" to a higher field - I will exchange the elements for I will trade the elements for the time, the elements for life, and the elements for miracles.

But something is gained and something is lost. What will be the price of everything you get in exchange for Alchemy?
So we created the puzzle part of the game, where the main character and his father love Astronomy and Geology, and their favorite meteorite will become the element of alchemy. The main character and the two girls have precious dolls in their memories, and their memories and beloved objects will also become elements of Alchemy.
↓

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42704084/0c7e9534e9d4852616f5dc7adebf8ac4f0673c16.jpg[/img]

This Alchemical Array in the game is not derived from the <Emerald Tablet> and <Poimandres>, the source behind our alchemy points to the outer gods ■■■■■. Therefore, we also adopt elements of ■■■■■. However, the background of our setting (spoilers here) is that the dependents of ■■■■■ infiltrated the East a long time ago to inflict destruction and stir up hearts. They adopted European Alchemical symbols to rewrite the rituals of ■■■■■ in order to make it easier to compel people.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42704084/d3d6068379243ddede7f1d13ece699c40f1e6b0f.jpg[/img]

The people who laid out the Alchemy Array want to use the greed of the human heart to hatch monsters, while the main characters reverse the Alchemy Array trying to save the city and the people they love.
Essentially all things are tools, love is eternal ............
............ right?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42704084/fac15e4845fd5d849a9a34269178d39cec671f77.jpg[/img]

follow us if you like！

notes.title: There is a fruit that will keep you in the underworld forever after eating it
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I am Ocarina from Bone Nail Studio, today in the finishing character dynamic when I saw the completion state of Student Xiaolin, I thought it was quite lamentable ......

Danruo Lin, in the game her nickname, is "Student Xiaolin". This character is one of our most discussed internally, from appearance to character to her ending, and...... her way of realization.

<YouYangZaZu> records "Pomegranate, also named Danruo. ...... Pomegranate sweet is called the heavenly pulp, can cure the poison of Stalactite." This word has a very thorough feeling of beauty.
Pomegranate is a kind of magical fruit, and delicious, and beautiful, but also particularly expensive. In Greek mythology, after Hades, the king of the underworld took the maiden Persephone to the underworld, Persephone ate the pomegranate and was no longer a fully earthly creature from then on. She possessed the attributes of Hades and henceforth needed to live on the ground and in Hades separately.

This is also a mythical explanation of the change of seasons in Greek mythology. From this perspective, the pomegranate is as if it were a delicious fruit with a strange dark atmosphere. The young girl consumed the fruit but became a resident of the underworld. How sweetly does the fruit need to be for the maiden to accept such an end?

We originally wanted to write a major character who was pushed by impermanent fate to become a deviation from her expectations, but she thought that the final form was her quest. However, when we designed the game, we did not give Student Xiaolin a lot of freedom of movement, she was more like an NPC. After many discussions(arguments), we defined Student Xiaolin as a girl who:
She aspires to a good life, but cannot define good.

She desires an adventurous career but is timid and pliable.
She wants to cling to someone lively and strong and wishes she could decide her fate.
She is such a sweet, soft, ordinary girl (the artist disagrees with this), crushed by the vagaries of fate. What first drove her on that fateful journey was a very small idea that cannot even be described as a "dream": 
I want to see the world, I want adventure.
[Here are the spoilers]
Then she turned into a monster.
[End of spoilers]

We are a puzzle-based game and do not include a monster fighting part, so this "monster" is more of a personality alienation.
Therefore, when discussing with the artist, we also wanted her to be a harmless-looking girl, but with a sense of vulnerability under the surface ......
(Thanks to the artist "sister" for not killing me) (Yes, the artist is called "sister") (Do not assume the gender of "sister"!)

notes.title: Game Production Gossip 01： Dig a hole for joy, fill a hole for pain
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I'm Ocarina, the producer of the Monster Dreamland series, ah sorry! Monster Dreamland the series has not been officially exposed to the public, our current external game is "Bloody Flowers", the first part of the overall monster AVG series we want to do Monster Dreamland constructed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42704084/d765c8fac38cfd3d0e328647d48bd35652dba392.png[/img]

Yes, this is a ...... giant pit that the three of us have been trying to dig.  

After being taught a lesson by our predecessors, our basic philosophy was that "no matter how grand a picture we want to paint, we have to get down to business and come up with a playable game", which was a blow and a shout for the team. The project and production process of these scattered in our various versions of the progress and chat records, now organized out of quite interesting, I will write a comprehensive production of these angles of handwriting, probably these aspects.


Character: the character and interaction of the main and supporting characters
Scenes: "A Tree" throughout the three eras
Story: a simple main line with three eras of transition and another line constructed with reading items
Puzzle: measurement of difficulty and length
Engineering: how to build a version with the brothers around and far away during a special time
Steam: the first time to build an account and access steam's SDK ......
......
Basically, every pit stepped on, is based on our naïve thought, really digging a pit a moment of pleasure, fill the pit ......

The process of filling the pit is quite happy.

First of all, back to the game. One of the team members has been writing various novels about the Meteorite Association since 2018, but as an extremely socially afraid person, he is not willing to come forward to talk about the story and the Association, so I'll say it for him.

This is a series of stories "meteorite will bring strange energy, open the thin wall between reality and non-reality, but the meteorite as the seed of xxxxxxx can hatch what kind of monster, depends entirely on the human who embraces the meteorite".
To feed the seeds of xxxxxxx with humanity, and the sight from the universe far away is watching everything. Although located in the highest gaze, able to cross time and space, the human will in this gaze seems to have no equivalent ability, and even can not be taken into account in the same numerical system, but, only the human will and choice, can fight with it, and change the fate originally written into time. The overall series is probably such a conception.
But the novel will become another thing in the game, the game needs not only to watch, read, but to experience, to turn the rhythm of the text into the rhythm of walking, adventure, and puzzle solving in the game, which is something we have been grinding for a long time, until now still tirelessly explore.
And in addition to solving puzzles, how to add more pieces about affection, gain and loss, and not so melodramatic, is also recently in the game script constantly polished point.

A small disclosure about the script: if you pay attention to the collection and reading part of the game, you will read a completely different story from the main line from the reading items.

Back to the team, we first met in the process of playing Hollow Knight, and also decided to make some games together because of our common love. At the beginning of making the game, we got some industry funding support.
